title: Is this Officer Avila's last post?
description:
Wait, is this really Officer Avila’s last post? 🕵️‍♂️🚫

After "sneaking" into the SMART Center and a "intense" Internal Affairs interview, Officer Avila is setting the record straight. No script, no coercion—just 100% genuine praise for his IA sergeants (and some majestic horses).

#SMARTCenter #PoliceHumor #IAInterview #SMPD #santamonica
transcript_text: Hello Blue Note Book family. Today we're out here at Lincoln Middle School for our Cops and Cleats event. We brought the mounted unit with us today. I would like to start off by saying thank you to my Internal Affairs Sergeants for that amazing interview last week. Turn the page. No, I am not being forced to say this, nor was I given a script to read. My Internal Affairs Sergeants are very hard working and amazing. Give two thumbs up. Here with me today is our Crime Prevention Coordinators for Beats 3 and In the arms >> [music] >> of the angel
